name: Witch's Brew
rationale: The compact high-contrast cauldron occupies the unobscured lower-right band, where its rim, bowl, handles, feet and localized fire remain readable around the gallery's course cards. Strong lower shelves and bottle silhouettes fill the open lower-left band, while the bright arched moon window and watchful cat hold the far-right edge. Lime and amber remain tightly reserved against the plum foundation.
motionNotes: Four fire tongues flicker independently; five bubbles rise on staggered slow loops; three shaped steam ribbons curl at separate rates; the cat's tail sways and its eyes blink; a five-node constellation appears briefly during each 20-second cycle. The workshop architecture and cauldron stay fixed, and the shader uses no procedural surface noise.
